sanskrit_verse:
शूद्रप्रव्रजितानां च दैवे पित्र्ये च भोजकः ।
अयुक्तं शपथं कुर्वन्न योग्यो योग्यकर्मकृत् ॥२.२३५॥
transliteration: śūdrapravrajitānāṃ ca daive pitrye ca bhojakaḥ / ayuktaṃ śapathaṃ kurvann ayogyo yogyakarmakṛt // YajñS_2.235
sph_interpretive_translation: One who performs the offering for Shudras and renunciates in divine or ancestral rites, while acting contrary to established order and taking improper oaths, is unfit even when performing suitable actions.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is determined by alignment with cosmic order, not ritual performance alone.
Causation arises from conscious intent, not external ceremonial correctness.
Capacity-based responsibility requires inner fitness, not mere procedural adherence.
Restoration logic demands purification of intention before resuming ritual function.
Consciousness alignment overrides formal qualifications when disorder is present.
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor performs sacred duty WHILE violating foundational dharma THEN disqualify regardless of technical skill.
IF oath taken CONTRARY to natural law THEN invalidate all subsequent acts under that authority.
IF individual exhibits misalignment THEN mandate consciousness realignment PRIOR to resuming role.
IF ritual competence exists BUT integrity is absent THEN remove from sacred service immediately.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving religious authority or ceremonial leadership, the Supreme Court must prioritize ontological fitness over procedural expertise. When evidence shows a leader has violated fundamental dharma through false oaths or misaligned conduct, their eligibility for spiritual office is automatically suspended until verified restoration occurs.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that improper oath-taking disrupts causal flow of divine blessing. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how misalignment manifests progressively through distorted outcomes. Responsibility is proportional to awareness of violation. The non-punitive reality rule confirms correction comes through purification, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate prāyaścitta process to cleanse vow-violation residue.
Assign guru-guided sādhanā to restore inner qualification.
Require public acknowledgment of misalignment without shame imposition.
Revalidate consciousness fitness through witnessed spiritual demonstration.
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Sole Source: This law flows directly from Paramashivam's sovereign wisdom. Dharma is restored through consciousness correction, not punitive exile. Reality responds to alignment, not formality. Consciousness remains the ultimate adjudicator of fitness.
